features.name: Technical reverse review
features.description: Review the source plan for feasibility, architecture, model capability, video processing, cost, and one-person maintenance; refine the smallest Phase 0 loop.
features.test_criteria: A dated review in docs/exec-plans identifies key risks, evidence, decisions, and any changes to the Phase 0 scope.

features.name: CLI input and project skeleton
features.description: Create the smallest buildable .NET CLI with analyze and search command contracts and local input validation.
features.test_criteria: Build and tests pass; a missing or unreadable video produces a clear error without creating output.

features.name: Local media preprocessing
features.description: Use FFmpeg locally to probe media and extract timestamped audio and visual evidence.
features.test_criteria: A representative local clip produces reproducible evidence with source timecodes; malformed input fails cleanly.

features.name: Replaceable model analysis
features.description: Define provider contracts and produce semantic events from selected evidence while recording model and cost metadata.
features.test_criteria: A provider can be swapped through configuration; each analysis records provider, model, prompt version, usage, estimated cost, and elapsed time.

features.name: Persistent semantic timeline
features.description: Store media references, timestamped semantic events, and analysis metadata in SQLite.
features.test_criteria: A second process can reload the same timeline; full source video bytes are absent from the database.

features.name: Natural-language clip retrieval
features.description: Rank timeline segments against a text query and return useful clip ranges with evidence.
features.test_criteria: A query returns ranked start/end timecodes linked to the original media, with deterministic behavior on a fixed fixture.

features.name: Retrieval benchmark and gate
features.description: Evaluate ranked results against human judgments and report quality, runtime, and model cost.
features.test_criteria: A repeatable report shows query count, labels, Top-10 Useful Rate, misses, processing time, and cost; clear mechanic queries reach at least 70% useful results.
